purpose: Application-agnostic compatibility contract between the MonkeySkill Store host and a generated evidence Runner.

input.build: A generated Build object with a modes map; each selected mode contains declarative CSS and JavaScript strings.
input.testSpec: A normalized schemaVersion 1 Developer Conformance object with behavior tests.

hostRequirements: The generated delivery includes the compatible Host adapter or a drop-in request compiler; installation switches both Runner and adapter atomically.
The compatibility matrix is invoked through the same authenticated localhost HTTP route used by the Extension.
The candidate mode is installed at the declared before-fixture or after-fixture boundary.
Each step captures a step-indexed observation checkpoint before the next step.
Unknown or uncompiled operations fail as infrastructure before any application Builder repair is emitted.
A direct private Runner request that bypasses the installed Host adapter is not acceptance evidence.
